title: A proper vector subspace has a nonzero annihilating functional
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $V$ be a finite-dimensional $k$-vector space [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace], and let $P\subsetneq V$ be a $k$-linear subspace. Then there exists a nonzero $k$-linear map $\lambda:V\to k$ such that $\lambda(p)=0$ for every $p\in P$.
